items.html: The general rule that emerges is that all the souls included in Adam HaRishon, which are in the ten aforementioned Partzufim, from Zeir of Beria to the Nukva of Assiya, were divided into three aspects, as follows: the first aspect, the highest of all, is called Zihara Ila'a, which was taken from Adam HaRishon — the Klipot did not rule over it at all, but it departed from him because of the sin he sinned, and he did not merit it again until Chanoch, who is Metatron, came and took it, as is written by us in Parashat Kedoshim, in Sitrei Torah, page 83b — see there. It is the aspect of the five lights called Yechida, Chaya, Neshama, and Ruach, which are in the Ketarim of every single Sefira, of the ten Sefirot in each and every one of the ten aforementioned Partzufim.
